rows.subject: the Christodoulou-Chrusciel L^2_loc-connection formulation, an intermediate extension class between C0 and C2

cells.quote: Not the C^0 formulation (which forbids even continuous extensions).
Not the C^2 formulation (L^2 connection is weaker than C^1, hence much weaker than C^2).

rows.intermediate_quote: A version of SCC in which the forbidden extension is one with continuous metric and Christoffel symbols in L^2_loc
rows.recommendation: neither frozen id is the row's subject; do not force a single binding. Record an explicit intermediate-extension-class marker and move both ids to informs_classes, or keep both with a transfer_argument documenting the intermediate relation.
rows.notes: The row is entry_kind=definition and its own does_not_imply distinguishes it from both frozen classes. Separately, review L0-review-18-current.json HF-03 records that its source SRC-029 is Einstein-Maxwell-scalar with Lambda>0, outside both vacuum classes by matter model; that is an HF-03 scope question, not an HF-02 disjunction question, and is only cross-referenced here.

rows.regularity_field: Metric C^{0,1} (Lipschitz), or C^0 with connection in L^s_loc, s>1.
rows.subject: the Lipschitz C^{0,1}_loc and L^s_loc-connection formulations, explicitly strictly between C0 and C2

cells.quote: None of these results settles the C^0 formulation.
C^{0,1}_loc-inextendibility does not imply C^2-inextendibility (a C^{0,1} extension could exist even if no C^2 one does).

rows.intermediate_quote: These formulations are strictly between the C^0 and C^2 formulations in strength.
rows.recommendation: same as D-004: intermediate marker + informs_classes, or transfer_argument; choosing one frozen class would misstate the row.
rows.notes: entry_kind=definition; the intermediate family is not one of the four frozen classes and the taxonomy registers variants only for other divergences.

rows.regularity_field: C^0 metric; Christoffel symbols not in L^2_loc.
rows.subject: a vacuum construction whose metric extends continuously while the Christoffel symbols fail to be square integrable

cells.quote: the metric extends continuously beyond the singularities while the Christoffel symbols fail to be square integrable
It shows the L^2-connection formulation (D-004) can fail in vacuum for a special class.

rows.recommendation: primary AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN (continuous-extension construction); the C2 id is relevance/contrast and moves to informs_classes. The genericity caveat stays attached: the data class is special, so the C0 subject relation is an obstruction input, not a decision of generic C0 SCC.

rows.subject: Lipschitz-inextendibility of the Kerr Cauchy horizon near i_+ (intermediate regularity)
rows.intermediate_quote: Between C^0 (T-301: extension exists) and C^2 (still open), Lipschitz is the intermediate verdict.
rows.recommendation: intermediate marker + informs_classes, or transfer_argument; the row's own does_not_imply rules out both subject relations.

rows.regularity_field: Between C^0 and C^2 (weak null singularity).
rows.subject: the revised SCC picture: C0-extendible Cauchy horizons that are generically higher-regularity singular

cells.quote: The Cauchy horizons arising in dynamical vacuum black holes that are C^0-extendible across a non-trivial piece are generically singular
hence a revised version of strong cosmic censorship (forbidding the relevant higher-regularity extension) is expected to hold

rows.recommendation: keep both bindings (or split the row into a C0-extension record and a C2-conjecture record); moving either id to informs_classes would drop a conclusion the row actually states. The C2 half is a conjecture supporting C2 SCC, the C0 half is an extension statement bearing negatively on C0 SCC.
rows.notes: This is also the one live row that the canonical detector flags as a bare composite, on its free-text regularity field (worker-063 W063-L0S-R2, T-402.regularity).

rows.subject: the status of the Kerr exterior nonlinear-stability antecedent

cells.quote: Status of the Kerr exterior stability antecedent
This entry directly constrains how far the Dafermos-Luk conditional refutation of C^0 SCC (T-301) reaches: at preprint level it now reaches the full subextremal range.

rows.recommendation: primary AF-WCC-VAC-GEN (status of the class's known obstruction/antecedent); the C0 id is a premise relation and moves to informs_classes with the verbatim antecedent note retained.

rows.subject: weak null singularity formation in generic rotating black-hole interiors: continuous extension, no Lipschitz extension

cells.quote: the spacetime metric is continuously extendible but not Lipschitz extendible
non-Lipschitz-extendibility implies non-C^2-extendibility; this inference is the ledger's (standard regularity inclusion), not a quoted sentence from the paper, and is flagged for F1 review

rows.recommendation: primary AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN (the construction is continuous-extendibility at C0); the C2 id needs a documented transfer_argument or moves to informs_classes, and the row itself already defers that transfer to F1. The AF-SCC binding is additionally provisional on the data being characteristic/interior rather than full asymptotically flat Cauchy data (row scope_caveats).

rows.subject: nonlinear stability of subextremal Kerr in the full subextremal range

cells.quote: nonlinear stability of subextremal Kerr black holes in the full subextremal range
Does not by itself prove C^0 SCC false; combined with Dafermos-Luk it discharges the antecedent (still modulo the interior-data assumptions of T-301).

rows.recommendation: primary AF-WCC-VAC-GEN; the C0 id is a premise relation and moves to informs_classes with the antecedent note retained.

aggregate.interpretation: Under the strict one-binding-class reading, 4/8 rows have a determinable single subject whose second id is relevance/antecedent/inference; 1/8 (T-402) asserts a relation to both classes; 3/8 (D-004, D-005, T-305) have no frozen-class subject at all because their subject is an intermediate extension class strictly inside the C0..C2 interval. The literal BL-6 instruction 'choose ONE class or move the second to informs_classes' therefore has a correct answer for 4/8 rows only.
